name: synergy_ramp_integration_cost_after_tax_breakeven_time
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A merger yields run-rate pre-tax cost savings of {RUN_RATE} USD million per year, realized {RAMP1} percent in year 1, {RAMP2} percent in year 2 and fully from year 3 onward. Integration costs are {COST1} USD million in year 1 and {COST2} USD million in year 2, none later. Tax rate is {TAX} percent. Each year's after-tax net cash flow equals realized savings minus integration cost, times one minus the tax-rate ratio; a negative pre-tax net gets a tax credit at the same rate. Cumulative net cash starts at zero and accrues evenly within each year. Break-even time is 0 if year-1 net cash flow is non-negative; otherwise, if the cumulative balance first reaches zero or more during year k, it equals k minus 1 plus the shortfall at the start of year k divided by year k's net cash flow. Find break-even time in years.

slots.description: After-tax net cash flow in year 1, negative if a net cost.
Cumulative after-tax net cash at the end of year 2.
Year in which cumulative balance first reaches zero or more.

program:
def solve():
    S = Q(P["RUN_RATE"])
    r1 = Q(P["RAMP1"]) / 100
    r2 = Q(P["RAMP2"]) / 100
    c1 = Q(P["COST1"])
    c2 = Q(P["COST2"])
    t = Q(P["TAX"]) / 100
    k = 1 - t
    f1 = (S * r1 - c1) * k
    f2 = (S * r2 - c2) * k
    f3 = S * k
    cum = Q(0)
    be_year = None
    be_time = None
    cum_end_y2 = None
    for y in range(1, 200):
        flow = f1 if y == 1 else (f2 if y == 2 else f3)
        start = cum
        cum = cum + flow
        if y == 2:
            cum_end_y2 = cum
        if be_year is None and cum >= 0:
            be_year = y
            if y == 1:
                be_time = Q(0)
            else:
                be_time = Q(y - 1) + (-start) / flow
        if be_year is not None and cum_end_y2 is not None:
            break
    if be_year is None:
        raise ValueError("no break-even")
    return {
        "final": be_time,
        "year1_net_after_tax": f1,
        "cumulative_end_year2": cum_end_y2,
        "breakeven_year": Q(be_year),
    }
